description: Enterprise tier. Get UTXO set breakdown by age cohort. Shows token amounts (BTC) and USD values for each cohort date. Useful for analyzing coin dormancy and accumulation patterns — when dormant supply moves, it often precedes price action. Other tiers get an access-denied message; for age-band supply and realized price use get_cohort_metrics.

date_processed.description: Specific processing date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the UTXO snapshot for that day.

name: get_utxo_history
